name: voxel-medical-imaging
description: Deploy a governed DICOM catalog, real DICOMweb serving (QIDO-RS/WADO-RS) with an OHIF viewer, MONAI Vista3D segmentation, and a cost harness into your own Snowflake account. Header-only ingest reads ~0.7% of corpus bytes; frame offsets are computed rather than stored. Ships with a public IDC demo corpus you can point away from your own stage.
